messages:
maria: Heads up — after the refactor deploy at 09:11 UTC I'm seeing 500s on /admin endpoints when the requester relies on an implicit role. Responses are PermissionDenied even though DB rows exist.
ken: saw the alert, thanks. Quick peek in auth-service logs shows PermissionDenied('missing:read:secrets').
devon: logs indicate role_lookup returned {} for role_id 1002 while role_versions has a row. Suspect cache staleness.
eli: can you grep for 'role_cache' and 'schema=' in the POD logs?
maria: grep results: `role_cache:miss key=implicit_v2:1002 schema=3` then `role_resolve:returned {}`. Multiple nodes show miss then blank.
ops-bot: Deployed auth-service v3.4.1 at 09:11:58 UTC by ken
sri: hypothesis: migration bumped role schema from 3 -> 4 (attr serialization changed). Cache keys are currently only role_id-based, not schema-aware. Nodes with old in-memory entries or mixed code paths can return empty attrs.
ken: if cache key doesn't include schema hash, a node that hasn't reloaded schema can serve incompatible cached blobs. That would explain the implicit-role drop.
devon: reproduced on staging: start v3.4.0, seed role_id=1002 with attrs {implicit:true, allow:[read]}, run schema migration -> schema=4, deploy v3.4.1 (no cache key change) -> observed same permission regressions.
maria: mitigation options: 1) hotfix auth-service to include schema hash in cache key; 2) purge role cache across fleet as immediate rollback. I can open a k8s job to call `/admin/cache/purge?pattern=role_*`. Example: `kubectl -n infra exec job/cache-purger -- curl -sS -XPOST "http://localhost:8080/admin/cache/purge?pattern=role_*"`
ken: I'll coordinate purge + hotfix. Plan: (A) run purge job (B) deploy hotfix (C) monitor audit logs and 500s.
eli: unrelated but FYI audit-logger shows missing events for some implicit grants between 09:11-09:22. KMS signer returned 401s — there was a KMS rotation at ~09:10.
maria: logs: `audit-logger: signer error: 401 unauthorized (kms policy)` — might be a separate failure but overlapping window. Could complicate replay.
sri: agree — two failure modes overlapped: (1) cache key/schema mismatch causing permission denials, (2) KMS rotation causing audit sign failures. Both need separate fixes.
devon: replay note: when re-ingesting events from event-sink, we need to apply the same schema mapping used at time of original emit. Otherwise replay will attach wrong/empty role attrs.
ken: immediate action items: 1) infra — restore KMS principal access to new key (INFRA oncall) 2) run cache purge across auth-service pods 3) roll hotfix with schema hash in cache key 4) re-ingest missing audit events using schema-aware rehydration tool.
maria: I'm starting the cache-purge job now. Also creating TEAM ticket for hotfix.
ops-bot: Job started: k8s job role-cache-purge triggered by ken at 09:40 UTC
ken: canary hotfix deploy started at 09:42 UTC (10% traffic). Monitoring logs.
maria: Canary looks good — no permission errors on canary nodes. Rolling to 100%.
ken: rollout complete at 09:50 UTC. Permission errors resolved, audit-logger 401s cleared after infra fixed KMS principal.
sri: follow-ups: create TEAM-4321 for "schema-aware cache keys + deploy gating", and INFRA-789 for "KMS principal rotation checklist and alerts". Add a pipeline check that any role/schema bump auto-triggers cache purge or compatible key strategy.
maria: also add alerting on audit-logger KMS 4xx rates during deploys.
eli: +1 to the alert, and please add a checklist item for replay tooling to accept historical schema mappings.
ken: I'll own the rollup ticket and coordinate postmortem notes.
maria: thanks all — great triage. :raised_hands:
